atomic_release_contract.executable_cache_policy: no-service-worker-executable-cache; verify-no-store-once then execute exact in-memory bytes
atomic_release_contract.upload_rule: all release files are flat at repository root; nested folders are not required for core or route visuals
atomic_release_contract.complete_runtime_preflight: every required runtime URL must return 200 before any application script executes
atomic_release_contract.visual_dependency_policy: route/decorative media can degrade or hold only that route; never block Engine boot

release_note: Plumb Line learns the scene background, isolates a strong wood core with cross-erosion, grows the true plank silhouette into pale sapwood without crossing into countertop/clutter, and gates 2 ft auto-resolution on shape stability and background separation. 4/6 ft remain provisional pending real stock examples.
